contentHtml:
Chocolate mint poke cake is a decadent dessert that pairs rich chocolate flavor with a refreshing hint of mint for a treat that feels both indulgent and festive. A moist chocolate cake is baked to perfection, then gently poked to soak up a creamy mint filling that adds cool sweetness in every bite. Topped with smooth chocolate ganache, fluffy whipped cream, and a sprinkle of crushed peppermint candy, this cake is as beautiful as it is delicious. Perfect for holidays, birthdays, or casual get-togethers, chocolate mint poke cake is a simple yet impressive recipe that will wow every guest.

Why You’ll Love This CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE

  • Decadent chocolate flavor paired with refreshing mint.
  • Moist and fluffy texture that melts in your mouth.
  • Easy to make, perfect for any occasion.
  • Impressive presentation that will wow your guests.
  • Customizable with your favorite toppings and drizzles.

CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE

Indulge in the rich flavors of CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE! This ultimate dessert delight is a must-try for chocolate lovers! 🍫🌿
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 15 minutes mins
Cook Time 30 minutes mins
Chilling Time 2 hours hrs
Total Time 2 hours hrs 45 minutes mins
Servings: 12 servings
Course: Dessert
Cuisine: American

Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Cake Ingredients
  • 1 box chocolate cake mix Your base cake
  • 1 cup water To mix with the cake mix
  • 1/2 cup vegetable oil Adds moisture
  • 3 large eggs Binds the ingredients
Filling Ingredients
  • 1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk For creamy goodness
  • 1/2 cup mint extract For that refreshing mint flavor
Topping Ingredients
  • 1 tub (8 oz) whipped topping For a fluffy layer
  • to taste optional green food coloring To enhance visual appeal
  • to taste optional chocolate shavings or mint candies For garnish

Equipment

  • 1 9×13-inch baking pan For baking the cake
  • 1 Large mixing bowl For mixing the batter
  • 1 whisk For mixing the filling
  • 1 Wooden spoon For poking holes in the cake

Method
 

Preparation Steps
  1. Step 1: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9×13-inch baking pan to ensure your cake comes out easily.
  2. Step 2: In a large bowl, combine the cake mix, water, oil, and eggs. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes until well blended and smooth.
  3. Step 3: Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Bake for 25–30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
  4. Step 4: While the cake is still warm, use the handle of a wooden spoon to poke holes all over the surface. This will allow the delicious filling to soak in.
  5. Step 5: In a medium bowl, whisk together the sweetened condensed milk and crème de menthe until smooth. Pour this mixture evenly over the cake, filling the holes generously.
  6. Step 6: Chill the cake in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. This helps the flavors meld beautifully.
  7. Step 7: If desired, fold green food coloring into the whipped topping. Spread it evenly over the chilled cake for a festive touch.
  8. Step 8: Garnish with chocolate shavings or mint candies. Slice, serve, and enjoy your delightful CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE!

How to Make CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE

This delightful CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE is a treat for any occasion! With a preparation time of 15 minutes, a cooking time of 25–30 minutes, and a chilling time of at least 2 hours, you’ll have a delicious dessert ready to impress your friends and family.

Step 1: Preheat the Oven

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9×13-inch baking pan to ensure your cake comes out easily.

Step 2: Mix the Batter

In a large bowl, combine the cake mix, water, oil, and eggs. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes until well blended and smooth.

Step 3: Bake the Cake

Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Bake for 25–30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

Step 4: Poke the Cake

While the cake is still warm, use the handle of a wooden spoon to poke holes all over the surface. This will allow the delicious filling to soak in.

Step 5: Add the Filling

In a medium bowl, whisk together the sweetened condensed milk and crème de menthe until smooth. Pour this mixture evenly over the cake, filling the holes generously.

Step 6: Chill the Cake

Chill the cake in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. This helps the flavors meld beautifully.

Step 7: Frost the Cake

If desired, fold green food coloring into the whipped topping. Spread it evenly over the chilled cake for a festive touch.

Step 8: Garnish and Serve

Garnish with chocolate shavings or mint candies. Slice, serve, and enjoy your delightful CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE!

Pro Tips for Making CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE

  • Use a high-quality cocoa powder for richer flavor.
  • Let the cake cool completely before poking for even absorption.
  • Chill the mint frosting for easier spreading.
  • Top with fresh mint leaves for a pop of color and flavor.

How to Serve this CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE

  • Top with whipped cream and chocolate shavings for extra flair.
  • Serve with a scoop of mint chocolate chip ice cream on the side.
  • Drizzle with chocolate syrup for a decadent touch.
  • Pair with fresh mint leaves for a refreshing garnish.
  • Enjoy with a cup of hot cocoa for a cozy treat.
  • Slice and serve with a dollop of cool whipped topping.
  • Offer alongside a fruit salad for a balanced dessert option.

Make Ahead and Storage

You can make this cake ahead and store it easily:

Storing CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE Leftovers

  • Cover the cake with plastic wrap or aluminum foil.
  • Store in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days.
  • Keep it in an airtight container for best freshness.

Freezing CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE

  • Wrap individual slices in plastic wrap tightly.
  • Place wrapped slices in a freezer-safe bag or container.
  • Freeze for up to 2-3 months for optimal quality.

Reheating CHOCOLATE MINT POKE CAKE

  • Thaw slices in the refrigerator overnight before reheating.
  • Microwave for 10-15 seconds for a warm treat.
  • For a fresh-baked feel, warm in the oven at 350°F for 5-10 minutes.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. What is the point of a poke cake?

A poke cake is designed to be moist and flavorful. The holes created in the cake allow for delicious fillings, like pudding or frosting, to seep in, enhancing the overall taste and texture. This method ensures that every bite is packed with flavor, making it a delightful dessert experience!

2. What is the difference between a dump cake and a poke cake?

The main difference lies in the preparation method. A dump cake typically involves dumping ingredients into a pan without much mixing, while a poke cake requires baking a cake and then poking holes in it to add a filling. This results in a more integrated flavor profile in poke cakes, as the filling seeps into the cake itself.

3. When making a poke cake, do you let it cool first?

Yes, it’s important to let the cake cool for a bit after baking before poking holes in it. This allows the cake to set properly and prevents the filling from running off. Typically, letting it cool for about 10-15 minutes is ideal before you start poking and adding your delicious fillings!

4. What is the difference between Devil’s food cake and Chocolate Cake?

Devil’s food cake is a richer, darker chocolate cake that often includes cocoa powder and baking soda, giving it a moist texture and a deep chocolate flavor. In contrast, regular chocolate cake can vary in richness and may use different types of chocolate or cocoa, resulting in a lighter flavor. Both are delicious, but Devil’s food cake is typically the go-to for chocolate lovers!

Final Thoughts

As you dive into this delightful Chocolate Mint Poke Cake, let the rich flavors transport you back to sweet memories! It’s a simple yet rewarding treat that’s perfect for any occasion. So grab your ingredients, get baking, and enjoy every delicious bite. Trust me, your taste buds will thank you!
